notes.title: Updates Screen Recorder 3
notes.content:
Supports more capture devices.
Supports capture previewing for Record and Stream mode.
Adds customizable video bitrate settings for Record and Stream mode.
Adds more webcam settings for capture resolution and frame rate adjustment.
Supports adjusting microphone volume and webcam settings during recording/streaming.
Supports the shadow file control feature to speed up the video preview in Edit mode.
Minor bug fixes.
